title: Update help content
description:
Plan Context: Replace per-store auto-increment numeric `id` on knowledge insights with UUID v4 strings, eliminating cross-store ID collisions and enabling stable IDs across moves/copies.

Description: Update all knowledge tool documentation strings in `help-content.ts` to reflect UUID-based IDs: parameter descriptions, example outputs, tips, and the `superseded_by` description.

Scope:
- `mcp-server/src/tools/help-content.ts`

Deliverables:
- Tool summary table entries for `ledger_update_insight` and `ledger_delete_insight` reference "UUID" instead of "numeric ID".
- Detailed help sections for each knowledge tool updated with UUID terminology.
- `KN-NNNN` display format example removed or replaced with UUID example.
- "Numeric IDs are per-store counters" tips replaced with "UUIDs are globally unique and stable across stores and moves".
- `superseded_by` description updated from "Numeric ID" to "UUID".
- `id` parameter descriptions updated from "Numeric insight ID" to "UUID of the insight".

Estimated Complexity: Low

Notes: This WP has no code dependencies — it can be done in parallel with WP-002 through WP-004 since it only modifies help string literals.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: No occurrence of "KN-NNNN", "numeric ID", "numeric insight ID", or "per-store counter" appears in knowledge-related help content.
All knowledge tool `id` parameter descriptions reference "UUID".
